sections.content_text: Section 243 - Requirement of Tax Payment Certificate of Person Leaving Bangladesh (1) Except as may be prescribed by the Board for this purpose, a person who is not domiciled in Bangladesh or who is domiciled in Bangladesh but at the time of leaving Bangladesh is of the opinion of Deputy Commissioner of Taxes of the nearest, namely:- (a) tax payment certificate, or (b) if he wishes to return to Bangladesh, an exemption certificate, which shall be issued only when the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes is satisfied that the person concerned so wishes and such exemption certificate may be issued in case of single journey or in case of multiple journeys within the period specified in the certificate. 2) If the owner or charterer of any aircraft or ship permits any person described under sub-section (1) to travel by such aircraft or ship from any place in Bangladesh to any place outside Bangladesh without the certificate mentioned in the said sub-section, in that case the owner or to the charterer- (a) shall pay the tax due or become due to the person mentioned in sub-section (1) and such tax shall be payable by him and shall pay a fine not exceeding Tk. 20,000 (twenty thousand); and (b) shall be deemed to be a defaulting taxpayer for the purpose of collection of such tax and penalty and all the provisions of this Act shall apply in that case. (3) For the purposes of this section- (a) in relation to a person, “exemption certificate” means a certificate issued for the purpose of exempting that person from payment of tax for one or more journeys specified in the certificate; (b) “owner” or “charterer” shall include the owner of any ship or aircraft or any representative, agent or servant authorized by the charterer to issue rights of passage in such ship or aircraft; (c) in the case of any person, the term “tax payment certificate” means that the person concerned has no liability under this Act or the Dan Kar Ain, 1990 (Act No. 44 of 1990) or to pay any tax of any kind to such person or to pay or become payable by him shall mean any certificate issued to the effect that satisfactory arrangements have been made for the purpose of payment of tax.
